_readme: What the warden says once the Keeper is down but the lantern is still dark.
Named only by games/quest/quest_hooks.gd, never by a map: which of her four lines she
says is the one piece of this game that is real code, and this is the branch the

heard.speaker: Warden
heard.text: You went in. And you came out.

quiet.speaker: Warden
quiet.text: Then the keep is only a building again. Light the lantern, and I will believe it.
